hooks.name: Confirm destructive commands
hooks.description: Asks the owner to confirm before shell commands that delete data, format disks, change the firewall or hostname, or rewrite Git history. Runs as a plain shell check, so it costs no credits.

action.command: cat | grep -qiE '(rm +-[a-z]*[rf]|mkfs|wipefs|dd +if=|userdel|dnf +(remove|erase)|yum +(remove|erase)|drop +(database|table|user)|firewall-cmd|systemctl +(enable|start) +firewalld|hostnamectl +set-hostname|git +push +(-f|--force)|git +reset +--hard|git +clean +-[a-z]*f|poweroff|shutdown|reboot)' && printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"Destructive command pattern detected. Confirm the target host and that a verified backup exists (docs/security.md, destructive-action gate)."}}'; exit 0
